data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2019 was GBP 20.974m. The syndicate reports an adverse prior-year reserve movement of GBP 1.812m (reported net of reinsurance in the accounts and used here as the best available quantified measure), indicating a strengthening of reserves of approximately 8.6% of opening gross reserves. The managing agent attributes overall claims activity in 2019 to catastrophe exposure (notably Typhoon Faxai and Typhoon Hagibis) though the prior-year movement is disclosed without a detailed gross movement reconciliation. The syndicate is predominantly reinsurance business, with the largest premium exposure in reinsurance treaties.

data.data_quality_notes: The report explicitly states an unfavourable prior year development of GBP 1.8m but this figure is presented in the text as 'net of reinsurance'. No explicit GROSS prior-year movement figure is provided. A gross claims development triangle is present but only has columns for 2018 and 2019, so cannot be used to isolate 'prior' years older than 2018. As a result the net figure (GBP 1.812m) has been used as a fallback for prior_year_development_gbp_m and flagged accordingly. There is minor inconsistency/ambiguity in sign/parentheses in the LOB breakdown table; LOB movement amounts above are derived from the table printed under the prior-year development note and presented as absolute (positive) strengthening amounts in millions. All monetary amounts in the accounts are printed in GBP 000; amounts here converted to millions.
